# CDL Entry Level Driver Training (ELDT): Passenger (P) Endorsement

> 6-hour online entry-level driver training theory for the CDL Passenger (P) endorsement under the FMCSA ELDT requirements (49 CFR Part 380). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com), listed on the FMCSA Training Provider Registry.

## Key facts
- Duration: 6 hours; 6 modules, 18 lessons, final exam (80% to pass)
- Credits: 0.6 CEU
- Price: $79.99 per person; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, mobile-friendly, audio playback
- Reporting: completion sent to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry
- Required since February 2022 before taking the P endorsement knowledge test
- Also required: valid CDL; medical exam by an examiner on FMCSA's National Registry; state passenger knowledge test; skills test (pre-trip inspection and driving test); a background check may be required
- Behind-the-wheel training: not included
- State acceptance: every state except Washington

## Modules
1. Emergency and Safety Procedures (post-crash procedures; other emergency procedures)
2. Pre-Trip and Operational Considerations (vehicle orientation; pre-trip, en-route and post-trip inspection; fueling; idling)
3. Cargo and Passenger Management (baggage and cargo; passenger safety awareness briefing; passenger management; ADA compliance)
4. Hours of Service and Safety Regulations (hours of service; belt safety; distracted driving)
5. Navigational Safety (railroad-highway grade crossings and drawbridges; weigh stations)
6. Security and Inspections (security and crime; roadside inspections; penalties and fines)

## Who should take it
Commercial drivers who may transport passengers: public transit, tour and motorcoach bus drivers; airport, hotel and hospitality shuttle drivers; luxury and party bus drivers; private bus drivers (estate management, security).
